title: The Luminous Deep Where Ache Becomes Rest

features.name: phosphor settlement
features.desc-on-touch: You find pockets where minerals have learned to hold light. Each glow breathes at its own tempo, a slow luminescence like the archive's own pulse made visible.

features.name: kept root-veins
features.desc-on-touch: You see roots that once ached for light, now resting in this deep place. The ache has become a permanent form, a white tracery that asks nothing more of the world.

features.name: sediment shelf
features.desc-on-touch: You find layer upon layer of settled things. The archive once worried about loss; this place proves that settling is its own form of keeping.

features.name: glow-grown fungal garden
features.desc-on-touch: You see small pale fruiting bodies that feed on the mineral light. They have learned to grow nowhere else, and ask nothing of the world but this luminous depth.

features.name: ache-quieted water
features.desc-on-touch: You find water that has stopped moving with urgency. It has learned to rest, and in its stillness you see the sky it cannot reach reflected perfectly back.

reverie.title: REVERIE — in the deep pool where ache settled
narr: You are floating in dark water, Katita beside
you, her hand finding yours in the deep. 'The
ache stops when you stop pulling,' she says.
Both of you sink deeper. The light follows.

inscription: the ache that learned to rest becomes the light that asks nothing of the sky
